title: Set up cap table
summary: Track every investment on a real cap table from day one — even informal rounds.

parts.title: Choose cap table tool
parts.guidance: Compare cap-table tools for the company’s jurisdiction, security types and expected financing or employee-equity activity. Examine permissions, transaction history, document links, modeling and exports with the people maintaining the records. Establish which legal registers and filings need separate maintenance, then choose a system that fits those responsibilities and the existing documents.

parts.title: Enter founding shares
parts.guidance: Reconstruct founding ownership from executed issuances, corporate approvals, consideration evidence and applicable registers. Match each holder to share class, quantity, issue date and restrictions. Separate authorized capital, issued shares and the unallocated reserve. The equity administrator enters supported opening holdings and takes gaps or conflicting documents to counsel, using the appropriate local register or depository process.

options.title: Default — Enter founding shares
options.summary: Enter founding issuances from the final corporate records, matching holders, classes, quantities, consideration, issue dates and vesting or repurchase terms. Reconcile totals to the capitalization authorized and actually issued. Link entries to their documents and resolve unexplained balances before using the table for fundraising or grants.

options.title: India - dematerialised shares
options.summary: Have the Indian company secretary establish whether dematerialisation rules apply to the company and securities. Assemble holder identities, classes, quantities and allotment evidence for the required depository or registrar process. The responsible company officer authorizes any instructions affecting holdings. Reconcile the resulting identifiers and balances to the company’s records, keeping unresolved physical or electronic positions visible.

options.title: UK - register of members + PSC
options.summary: Reconcile UK founding holdings to the register of members and executed allotments, including member identities, classes, quantities and amounts paid. Assess PSC reporting separately from the relevant rights and confirmed control information. The authorized officer updates registers and submits required Companies House information, keeping the software cap table aligned with the underlying legal records.
options.when: Recording founding shares in the United Kingdom

options.title: Germany - Gesellschafterliste
options.summary: Compare the German GmbH’s founding ownership with formation documents and the filed shareholder list, checking identities, numbered interests, nominal amounts and participation details. Determine who must update the list under the transaction: section 40 gives duties to managing directors and, in relevant cases, an involved notary. Reconcile the working cap table to the resulting filed record.

parts.title: Record investments/SAFEs
parts.guidance: Record investments from executed agreements and funding evidence, including investor, amount, instrument version, conversion terms and side-letter rights. Keep outstanding convertibles separate from issued equity and identify modeled conversion scenarios as projections. The authorized equity administrator reconciles totals to finance’s receipts and resolves differences between the records and controlling documents.

parts.title: Verify cap table
parts.guidance: Trace the opening cap table to the charter, issuance approvals, agreements, consideration evidence and local ownership records. Reconcile class totals, option reserve, outstanding convertibles and fully diluted assumptions for omissions or double counting. Resolve unexplained differences with the equity owner and send legal defects to counsel; correcting a software entry alone cannot repair deficient corporate authority.

geoNotes.summary: Since the 2023 MCA amendment, private companies (other than small ones) must DEMATERIALISE their shares — an ISIN via NSDL/CDSL, shares held in demat accounts, and half-yearly PAS-6 reconciliation — so the 'cap table' has an official electronic backbone.

The legal record is the company's own register of members plus the public PSC (people with significant control) register at Companies House — cap-table software mirrors those registers, not the other way round.

The cap table has one authoritative form: the Gesellschafterliste filed in the Handelsregister (§ 40 GmbHG), updated by the notary after every transfer — only listed holders count as shareholders against the company.

metadata.supportReason: Carta integration is planned. Cap table setup requires manual data entry or document upload.
